# self-update: pull docker images

Fix `self-update docker` on a host with untagged images:

```
$ self-update docker
...
invalid reference format
invalid reference format
invalid reference format
invalid reference format
...
# exit code 1
```

because

```
$ images all
redis                                <none>                              40acfa265b76   3 weeks ago    32.4MB
nginx                                <none>                              3dc166bc6b35   3 weeks ago    22MB
golang                               <none>                              a6562e325080   4 weeks ago    805MB
minio/mc                             <none>                              35295c93c07e   4 weeks ago    158MB
```

The update built `repo:tag` from `docker images --all` and tried to `docker pull redis:<none>` for every dangling layer; each failed, and the last failure was the exit code of the whole `self-update`.

Expected: only tagged images are re-pulled; dangling ones are ignored (or cleaned, [[DOT-413]]).
